# teams_shared_calling_routing_policy (Resource)

Manages the SharedCallingRoutingPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsSharedCallingRoutingPolicy / Get-CsTeamsSharedCallingRoutingPolicy / Set-CsTeamsSharedCallingRoutingPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsSharedCallingRoutingPolicy.

### Optional

- `emergency_numbers` (String) Maps to the -EmergencyNumbers parameter.
- `resource_account` (String) Maps to the -ResourceAccount parameter.
